summary: B2Gold Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K containing its unaudited condensed interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing is a routine quarterly report required under SEC Rule 13a-16. It includes income statements, statements of comprehensive income, cash flows, and notes but does not announce any special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, restructuring, or delisting. The report shows normal operating results for a gold mining company with no extraordinary corporate actions disclosed.
